content: Let $f(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{cc}e^{x-1} & , x<0 \\ x^2-5 x+6 & , x \geq 0\end{array}\right.$ and $g(x)=f(|x|)+|f(x)|$. If the number of points where $g$ is not continuous and is not differentiable are $\alpha$ and $\beta$ respectively, then $\alpha+\beta$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$
